speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Fish, and eggs after. Sit, the pair of you. Sixpence each, and I am not keeping a kitchen hot for a man with papers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four sheets, Mistress Tipping. He asked, in a manner of speaking. I brought them.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Not the manner. The paper. Quarrel first, if that is the first.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two men throwing their gages, and a king between them, graceful and already wrong. He likes a peace that is only his voice.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I can hear him liking it. The lists.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Coventry. He drops a warder, and the fight ends because he has said so. Then the years. Ten to one of them, and four given back in the next breath, so it is six, and the man is meant to thank him.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He does it because he can.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sentence is the long sheet. I was about to read it out.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Give me the long one again. No, don't read it, give it to me.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: The chimney has not paid me sixpence, Master Burbage. When you are done with it, the eggs are on the settle.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Done. He's pleased with every word he says. I know that man. Write me the rest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a fourth. It is not his speech. It is the other man, the one sent out. Within my mouth you haue engaold my tongue.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I am not asking thee for that one. Who will play it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The eggs are cold. I am eating them.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: I said I would not nurse them. Who plays a banished man is no question for my settle. Sixpence is the question, and it is the same sixpence as any other night.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wilt not name him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not name him tonight. Eat the fish, Dick. It is the hot thing left.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: That's a jackdaw on my sign, not a court. Papers are welcome. Casting is not. More fish if either of you is still hungry.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Four sheets. Quarrel, lists, the sentence, and a farewell thou art keeping. I know which man is mine. I asked who the other is. Thou art chewing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am chewing because the eggs would not wait, and the name will not be said at a table. Thou hast the king who enjoys his sentence. That is the part that asked for thee.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: By this hand, he does enjoy it. A strong man at being easy with other men's years. Write the rest when thou art home. I will not have a name dragged out of a cold egg.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Then the slate is two sixpences, and the fire is free, and I am taking the jug away before it joins the company.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two sixpences. Put them down. The sheets go home with me.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Take them. I have the man in my mouth already. The other man can wait for a player who is not me.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Sit through the end of the fish, Master Burbage. You have given the chimney a speech. You can finish it sitting.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are done reading. The rest is not written, and it is not cast.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then write it. Thou knowest the man. I have told thee so.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: And pay before you tell each other again. The door is that way when the plates are clear.
